# planetscale_neki_routers (Data Source)

Returns Neki routers for a branch.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "planetscale_neki_routers" "my_nekirouters" {
  branch       = "...my_branch..."
  database     = "...my_database..."
  organization = "...my_organization..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `branch` (String)
- `database` (String)
- `organization` (String)

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) Returns routers for the branch. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the branch's default router.
- `name` (String) The stable name of the router.
- `replicas_per_cell` (Number) The number of router replicas in each cell.
- `sku` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data--sku))
- `state` (String) The rollout state of the router.

<a id="nestedatt--data--sku"></a>
### Nested Schema for `data.sku`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `ram` (Number)
- `sort_order` (Number)
